summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting an exploration and option agreement between its subsidiary BCE and KGHM subsidiary RHUSA on four Nevada copper projects. Terms include execution payments of US$315,000, option payments up to US$600,000 per project over six years, and US$5M work commitments per project. Upon exercise, Elemental retains a 2% NSR royalty plus AAR and milestone payments. This is a routine business development disclosure, not a special situation transaction—no acquisition, divestiture, or change of control of the registrant itself. This 6-K replaces a Form 8-K for a foreign private issuer.
